description: This file is a PHP template responsible for rendering a 'sponsors' sidebar widget, displaying sponsor logos with links, and including some dynamic content fetched via PHP variables.
external_files: Some external image links via `$sponsor->image->getLink()`, though actual filenames are determined at runtime.
The `$sponsors` object/array, which holds sponsor data, is dynamically set elsewhere in the application.

methods.name: text
methods.description: Retrieves localized text strings or labels, used here for 'node-header-sponsorby'.
